svg.title: Embedding operator costs · jit-on · scatter_add
svg.text: Dots: each process p50. Hollow: that variant fails eligibility. No ratio is shown unless both variants qualify.
Blue: unchanged main source. Orange: patched source. C: compiled; E: eager. V: vocabulary; W: width; N: token count.
Solid dots: that variant passes accuracy and exact replay. Ratios require both variants. Other costs are descriptive only.
